title: The final direction of the directed-colimit characterization repeats the wrong implication label.
details: Theorem5.15, printed p.55, labels the final direction (3)⇒(1) again, but the argument starts from preservation under omega-chain colimits and derives the syntactic universal-existential characterization, hence proves (2)⇒(3). The adjacent proof itself has the intended hypotheses and conclusion. Relabeling the direction repairs this local slip; the corpus states and proves each theory-level implication explicitly.
